capabilities: Apply hotkey mapping presets from Visual Studio Code, JetBrains, or Visual Studio
Move, duplicate, sort, join, and split selected lines
Transform selected text case, casing styles, and URI encoding
Insert callouts, code blocks, tables, and ordinal numbering
Manage multiple carets, selections, and regex search and replace
extras: README documents hotkey conflicts with default Obsidian actions and ships with a "Clear" preset (no default hotkeys) following Obsidian team recommendations; preset can also be changed via a command modal.
problem: Obsidian's editor lacks the line, selection, caret, and text-transform commands that users are used to from code editors, and its defaults differ from IDE keymaps.

relations.evidence: If you have internal plugin Quick Switcher enabled, then this shortcut will open quick switcher window

summary: Command set that brings IDE-style editor shortcuts and commands from Visual Studio Code, JetBrains IDEs, and Visual Studio into Obsidian's editor.
